metadata.question: On July 20, 2025 at 10:44 am local time, was there a volcanic eruption in Halema‘uma‘u Crater, the summit caldera of Hawaii’s Kīlauea volcano?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Location: Halema‘uma‘u Crater, Kīlauea, Hawaii (point with ~1 km buffer).
- Time: 2025-07-20 10:44 HST = 2025-07-20 20:44 UTC. Primary window ±10 min; fallback ±60 min.
- Collections (priority): NOAA/GOES/18/MCMIPF (Full Disk, 3.9 µm CMI_C07), fallback NOAA/GOES/17/MCMIPF.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Use GOES ABI Channel 7 (3.9 µm) brightness temperature; clouds are cold, no explicit cloud mask needed.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Check collection size; if 0 even after fallbacks/windows -> C1.
- Check valid pixel counts after selecting band -> if 0 -> C2.
- If any key metric (maxBT/bgMean) is null/NaN or outside plausible range (100–500 K) -> C3.
- Decision: eruption likely if maxBT >= 330 K and (maxBT - bgMean) >= 15 K.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const craterCenter = ee.Geometry.Point([-155.2839, 19.4069]); // Halema‘uma‘u approximate center
    const crater = craterCenter.buffer(1000); // ~1 km buffer for crater area
    const bgOuter = craterCenter.buffer(6000); // outer 6 km
    const bgInner = craterCenter.buffer(2000); // inner 2 km
    const background = bgOuter.difference(bgInner, 1);

    const targetUTC = ee.Date('2025-07-20T20:44:00Z');
    const windows = [
      {start: '2025-07-20T20:34:00Z', end: '2025-07-20T20:54:00Z', label: '±10min'},
      {start: '2025-07-20T19:44:00Z', end: '2025-07-20T21:44:00Z', label: '±60min'}
    ];
    const datasets = [
      'NOAA/GOES/18/MCMIPF',
      'NOAA/GOES/17/MCMIPF'
    ];
    const band = 'CMI_C07'; // 3.9 µm – best for hot spot detection
    const scale = 2000; // meters

    function getClosestImage(col, targetMillis) {
      const withDiff = col.map(img => img.set('tdiff', ee.Number(img.date().millis()).subtract(targetMillis).abs()));
      return ee.Image(withDiff.sort('tdiff').first());
    }

    function getNumber(val) {
      return val === null || val === undefined ? null : val;
    }

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback logic
    let chosen = null;
    let usedDataset = null;
    let usedWindow = null;
    let imagesCount = 0;
    let imgTimeStr = null;
    let timeDiffMin = null;

    for (let w of windows) {
      for (let ds of datasets) {
        const col = ee.ImageCollection(ds).filterDate(w.start, w.end);
        const size = await col.size().getInfo();
        console.log(`Window ${w.label} ${w.start}→${w.end} UTC | ${ds} Images: ${size}`);
        if (size === 0) continue;

        const targetMillis = await targetUTC.millis().getInfo();
        const img = getClosestImage(col, targetMillis);
        imagesCount = size;
        usedDataset = ds;
        usedWindow = w.label;

        // Basic band presence check
        const bands = await img.bandNames().getInfo();
        if (!bands || bands.indexOf(band) === -1) {
          console.log(`Band ${band} not found in ${ds}.`);
          continue;
        }

        chosen = img;
        const ts = await img.date().format('YYYY-MM-dd HH:mm:ss').getInfo();
        imgTimeStr = ts + 'Z';
        const imgMillis = await img.date().millis().getInfo();
        timeDiffMin = Math.round(Math.abs(imgMillis - targetMillis) / 60000);
        break;
      }
      if (chosen) break;
    }

    if (!chosen) {
      console.log("No images found in all windows/datasets.");
      console.log("C1");
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing & Valid Pixel Counts
    const countDictCrater = chosen.select(band).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: crater,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    });
    const countCrater = getNumber((await countDictCrater.get(band).getInfo()));

    const countDictBg = chosen.select(band).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: background,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    });
    const countBg = getNumber((await countDictBg.get(band).getInfo()));

    console.log(`Chosen Image (UTC): ${imgTimeStr} | Δt: ${timeDiffMin} min`);
    console.log(`Valid Pixels - Crater: ${countCrater || 0}, Background: ${countBg || 0}`);

    if (!countCrater || countCrater === 0 || !countBg || countBg === 0) {
      console.log("No valid pixels after selection.");
      console.log("C2");
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation of Brightness Temperature stats
    const maxCraterDict = chosen.select(band).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.max(),
      geometry: crater,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    });
    const meanCraterDict = chosen.select(band).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: crater,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    });
    const meanBgDict = chosen.select(band).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: background,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    });

    const maxBT = getNumber(await maxCraterDict.get(band).getInfo());
    const meanCrater = getNumber(await meanCraterDict.get(band).getInfo());
    const meanBg = getNumber(await meanBgDict.get(band).getInfo());

    console.log(`Dataset: ${usedDataset} | Window: ${usedWindow} | Images: ${imagesCount}`);
    console.log(`CMI_C07 BT (K) - Crater max: ${maxBT !== null ? maxBT.toFixed(2) : 'null'}, mean: ${meanCrater !== null ? meanCrater.toFixed(2) : 'null'}`);
    console.log(`CMI_C07 BT (K) - Background mean: ${meanBg !== null ? meanBg.toFixed(2) : 'null'}`);

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    // Check for invalid/null or out-of-range values
    const invalid =
      maxBT === null || meanCrater === null || meanBg === null ||
      isNaN(maxBT) || isNaN(meanCrater) || isNaN(meanBg) ||
      maxBT < 100 || maxBT > 500 || meanCrater < 100 || meanCrater > 500 || meanBg < 100 || meanBg > 500;

    if (invalid) {
      console.log("Computation invalid (null/NaN/out-of-range).");
      console.log("C3");
      return;
    }

    const delta = maxBT - meanBg;
    console.log(`Delta (Crater max - Background mean): ${delta.toFixed(2)} K`);
    console.log(`Decision thresholds: maxBT>=330 K and Delta>=15 K`);

    const eruptionLikely = (maxBT >= 330) && (delta >= 15);

    // Final line: exact tag only
    if (eruptionLikely) {
      console.log("A");
    } else {
      console.log("B");
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error:', err);
    console.log("D");
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
